desc: The Coyote Reaper XXL Spotlight by Predator Tactics is a powerhouse that delivers a beam throw that will reach distances up to 750 yards modestly. The Coyote Reaper Spotlight features a 3/4 turn flood to spot adjustable focus, an intensity control ON/OFF dial with a 5% to 100% range and built-in memory, different interchangeable LED bulb module colors (green/red/white) to choose from and it's all housed in an aircraft grade aluminum alloy.
